name: Team Fortress 2
hint: Valve's class-based shooter server, joined by Fake IP through Steam's relay

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.description: Written into server.cfg on the first start. Players join through Steam Datagram Relay: open the developer console and run connect with the address from the app's logs line "FakeIP allocation succeeded: 169.254.x.x:port"; check it again after a restart. The first start downloads about 15 GB.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Leave empty for an open server; players otherwise run password <value> before connect.

RCON_PASSWORD.title: RCON password
RCON_PASSWORD.description: Replaces the image's default. RCON runs over TCP, which Steam's relay does not carry, so it only works from the app's terminal.

SRCDS_TOKEN.title: Game Server Login Token
SRCDS_TOKEN.description: Optional, from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers with App ID 440. Only needed to show the server in the in-game server browser.
